inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, once again we see that when the political establishment and corporate interests fail to look out for our communities, it is ordinary, grounded folks and grassroots organizers who have to step up and do the heavy lifting to protect our most vital traditions and local heritage. 

Down in southern Alberta, local canvassers are out there taking to the petition tables and collecting signatures to defend our land and water from the destructive legacy of coal mining. This vital push was launched by Corb Lund last month, centering on the Water Not Coal citizen initiative petition, which rightly demands that the Government of Alberta step in and “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” 

We have a duty to protect the water sources that families and future generations depend on for their survival and continuity. When the modern political apparatus fails to secure the basics of community wellbeing, it is up to responsible citizens at the local level to demand accountability and preserve what matters most.
